// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  // Hoist loop-invariant accelerator configuration outside the i0/j0 loop.
  // flush, config_ex, config_ld (A stride), and config_st are all invariant
  // across all (i0, j0) tile iterations — issue once before the loop.
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
  gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));   // A stride; set once, reused at top of each iteration
  gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));    // output stride; invariant across all tiles

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++)
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      // PROF cpu_stage
      // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales; A/B data is mvin'd DIRECTLY
      // from DRAM (no host-side block memcpy — that was 98% of the cycles).
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }
      int tiles = BLK / DIM, tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 128;
      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;
      // PROF accel
      // Programming model sequence must be followed exactly:
      // config_ex (hoisted) -> load_scales -> mvin -> mxquant_config_mvout -> loop_ws_spad -> read_smem -> fence

      // Step 1: config_ex already issued before the loop (hoisted).

      // Step 2: Load scale factors for this tile's A and B blocks.
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);   // sel=0 -> A (activation) scales
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);   // sel=1 -> B (weight) scales

      // Step 3: No LUT load needed (uselut=0, fp8 path).

      // Step 4: MVIN tiles of A into scratchpad.
      // config_ld for A stride was hoisted; it is still active at this point
      // because the B mvin of the *previous* iteration ends with B-stride config,
      // so we must re-issue the A-stride config at the start of each iteration.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));           // re-establish A stride after prev B mvin
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Step 4 (continued): MVIN tiles of B into scratchpad.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));           // B stride: switch from A stride
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)                         // B[k][j0*BLK+j] -> slot (k*tiles + j)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Step 5: Configure requantized mvout (config_st already hoisted).
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles, tiles, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Step 6: Execute tiled weight-stationary matmul over the scratchpad.
      // mx_loop_spad_marker is one-shot; gemmini_loop_ws_spad re-issues funct 24
      // internally before funct 8, satisfying the re-issue requirement.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Step 7: Drain BF16-packed results from mx_smem to DRAM, then fence.
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
}
